definition: Completed sqlx::query events inside the HTTP request scope. Includes authentication, transaction context/setup, application SQL, and COMMIT. Excludes SQLx's protocol-level BEGIN because SQLx 0.9 does not emit a query event for it. Detached usage bookkeeping is intentionally outside the foreground request scope.

baseline.method: Pinned from the default-safe simple-core statement shape; the first D09-enabled isolated-stack run records all observed counts and must match these budgets before the baseline is considered measured.
